During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''battle''' occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kovor]] when an [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial fleet]], led by the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Ace/Legends|ace]] [[Tervor Jheran|Tervor "Riptide" Jheran]], ambushed a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic patrol]]. The Republic wasn't able to organize any considerable fleet in time to save the patrol so they sent the renowned [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron to delay the Imperial attack, providing enough time for Republic reinforcements to arrive. Coruscant Aegis, although outmatched, was able to destroy most of the Empire's starfighters and even damage slightly the Imperial capital ships. Eventually the Republic reinforcements arrived and the Imperial fleet retreated.
